_README: Hand-labelled ground truth for retrieval evaluation, mirroring labels.json's extraction eval. Each query is deliberately phrased with little lexical overlap with the source sentence it targets, so a pass requires real semantic retrieval (not just BM25 keyword matching) to rank the right passage in the top k. 'ticker' scopes retrieval the way the Q&A tab's company selector does; 'expect_any' passes if at least one of the substrings (case-insensitive) appears in the top-k retrieved chunks' text.
